candidate_relations.reason: Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome requires capillary malformations, which are not described, and does not explain femoral aplasia.
Prenatal oligohydramnios sequence is an associated gestational finding but not the femoral–facial malformation diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: oligohydramnios sequence as associated pregnancy finding

case_quality_flags: Femoral aplasia/hypoplasia plus facial cleft in the setting of oligohydramnios is the femoral–facial syndrome pattern; maternal diabetes was denied
